title: URL parser misses the scheme of a URL prefixed with blank characters, defeating scheme blocklists
source: Real-world defect (reconstruction): CPython urllib.parse.urlsplit pre-fix logic for CVE-2023-24329 (blocklist bypass via URLs starting with blank characters), fixed upstream by CPython commit 2f630e1ce18ad2e07428296532a68b11dc66ad10 (gh-102153, GH-102508, first released in 3.11.4); the defective function is reconstructed standalone in this case, 2026-11-05
